factual_errors.text: A huge spark between a charged storm cloud and the ground.
factual_errors.correction: This definition is incomplete. Lightning is a large electrical discharge (spark) that can happen within a cloud, between clouds, or between a cloud and the ground. Cloud-to-ground is only one type. Most lightning does not reach the ground.

wrong_terms.text: Two charged rods with the same sign: repel (swing apart on threads)
wrong_terms.spec_term: Two objects that carry the same type of charge repel.

wrong_terms.text: Two charged rods with opposite signs: attract (swing together)
wrong_terms.spec_term: Two objects that carry different types of charge attract.
The material that loses electrons is left with an equal positive charge.
